fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $79,500 (non-refundable, with Franchise Deposit of $9,500 credited toward it). Reduced fee of $49,500 is available to franchisees in good standing under affiliated brands (Signarama, Fully Promoted, TBA, TGG, GCZ, OE, EXF, and IO) who meet multi-brand criteria. Veterans (honorable discharge) and/or military spouses receive a 10% discount on the franchise fee. Under a Multi-Unit Development Agreement (MUDA), each additional facility beyond the first carries an Initial Franchise Fee of $49,500 (less a $20,000 credit from the Development Fee).
raw_excerpt: When you sign your Franchise Agreement, you must pay VTX an initial franchise fee amount to $79,500 (the "Initial Franchise Fee"). If you have paid a Franchise Deposit, then that amount shall be credited toward your Initial Franchise Fee. The Initial Franchise Fee is deemed fully earned upon payment and is non-refundable. VTX expects to uniformly impose this Initial Franchise Fee, except as provided in the following bullet points: • Franchise owners in good standing under a Franchise Agreement with certain of our affiliated brands (Signarama, Fully Promoted, TBA, TGG, GCZ, OE, EXF, and IO) may be afforded the opportunity to acquire a franchised Space for a reduced non-refundable Initial Franchise Fee of $49,500... • Veteran Appreciation. Eligible United States military veterans (and/or military spouses) will receive a discount of 10% of the franchise fee or 5% of the then current transfer fee.
